name: @lazyz/plugin
description: LazyZ — ZCode plugin distribution of the OmO agent harness (project memory, planning, execution, verified completion).

scripts.build: node scripts/sync-version.mjs && node scripts/sync-hook-status-messages.mjs && node scripts/build-bundled-mcp-runtimes.mjs && node scripts/materialize-shared-upstreams.mjs --strict && node scripts/sync-skills.mjs && node scripts/build-cli.mjs && node scripts/build-components.mjs
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run typecheck:components && npm test && npm run test:components && npm run test:vendor && npm run check:zcode
scripts.test:components: for manifest in components/*/package.json; do dir=${manifest%/package.json}; npm --prefix "$dir" run test --if-present || exit 1; done
scripts.typecheck:components: for manifest in components/*/package.json; do dir=${manifest%/package.json}; npm --prefix "$dir" run typecheck --if-present || exit 1; done
